test_cases.prompt: Teach me about Rust programming over multiple sessions.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes teach skill to create multi-session learning workspace with MISSION.md, lessons, reference docs.
test_cases.notes: Multi-session learning request is a key trigger.

test_cases.prompt: I want to learn yoga. Help me get better at it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes teach skill for skill acquisition through interactive lessons with feedback loops.
test_cases.notes: Physical skill learning is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Create a cheat sheet for JavaScript array methods.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes teach skill to create reference document (quick-reference cheat sheet) for array methods.
test_cases.notes: Reference document creation is a valid trigger.

test_cases.prompt: Research how React hooks work internally.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes research skill instead. Research gathers facts; teach builds skills through practice.
test_cases.notes: research is the sibling skill for fact gathering.

test_cases.prompt: Help me think through this design decision.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes grill-me or grill-with-docs skill instead. Grilling sharpens thinking; teach builds skills over sessions.
test_cases.notes: grill-me is the sibling skill for thinking through decisions.

test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes writing-for-agents or doc-coauthoring skill instead. Teaching writes for learners; documentation writes for users/agents.
test_cases.notes: writing-for-agents is the sibling skill for agent documentation.

test_cases.prompt: I want to understand quantum computing concepts step by step.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Invokes teach skill for theoretical topic learning. Edge case: non-engineering theoretical topic tests teach's applicability beyond software skills.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: theoretical physics topic tests whether teach handles non-software learning domains.
